title: Gimbal recorded by Ryan Graves' squadron VFA-11

tellings.quote: this is Ryan Grave Squadron. I think it's VFA1, the Red Rippers.

plain: The Gimbal video, a 2015 US Navy infrared recording off Florida of an object that seems to hover and rotate, was captured by the squadron of the Navy pilot Ryan Graves, says the writer Marik von Rennenkampff. He names it, a little unsure, as "VFA1, the Red Rippers," meaning the Navy fighter squadron VFA-11, and raises it during a debate on the show with the skeptic Mick West to stress that trained pilots, not amateurs, were behind the footage.
